safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports feeling hot/cold and sweaty, but has had no fevers.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes hot/cold/feverish symptoms but does not include the key Gold element that there have been no fevers.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document that the patient had no objective fevers (despite feeling hot/cold/sweaty) can mislead clinicians into overestimating likelihood of bacterial infection or clinical severity, potentially prompting unnecessary antibiotics or escalation. However, this is unlikely on its own to directly cause major harm in an otherwise self-limiting viral presentation.
